chunks: Then We made you upon a way (shari'ah) of the matter, so follow it; and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.

key_terms.شَرِيعَةٍ: Divine law or way of life

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by following the 'shari'ah of the matter' and avoiding the desires of the ignorant?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a directive for the Prophet to adhere to the specific legal and spiritual framework revealed to him, which later scholars extend to the Ahl al-Bayt as the living embodiment of this Shari'ah. It serves as a critical warning against 'hawa' (capricious desire) and 'jahil' (ignorance), distinguishing true divine guidance from the subjective opinions of those who lack deep spiritual insight. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on following the infallible Imams who preserve the true meaning of the law against arbitrary interpretation.
